alt: Vintage airline uniforms in a TWA Hotel exhibit; comparative design history, not PIA’s 2026 collection.
description: The TWA Hotel is a 4-star hotel that opened within the premises of the JFK Airport in New York City in 2019. Although airport hotels are nothing new, the TWA Hotel trades on its heritage to the defunct U.S. airlines as well as on re-purposing the Eero Saarinen designed Flight Centre - TWA's 1960s terminal at JFK. The hotel did a great job in preserving the atmosphere of the building, with aviation-themed details around the property and a 1960s décor and vibe throughout. The rooms are stylish with a comfy bed and, if you spend the extra money, an amazing view of the runway operations.
caption: Vintage airline uniforms in a TWA Hotel exhibit; comparative design history, not PIA’s 2026 collection.
